Hand-crafted fixture for ARX-CONSTRUCTS-363.

Covers macros flagged unsafe by `_unsafe_macro_body` in
`src/arxiv_md/tex/macros.py` (here: body uses `\csname ... \endcsname`,
which is in the unsafe-token regex alongside `\if...`, `\catcode`,
`\write`, `\input`, `\include`).

Behavior locked by this fixture:
- `\lookup` is NOT installed in the macro table.
- Each call site falls back through `UnknownCommandHandler` in
  `src/arxiv_md/tex/transform/inline.py`, which emits the mandatory
  argument's children as plain text. No expansion of the unsafe body.
- A `macro_expansion_skipped` warning is produced ("Unsafe macro
  preserved: \\lookup"). Warning shape itself is asserted in
  property / typed-error tests; this fixture just locks the fallback
  render so refactors of the macro engine notice if the fallback
  output drifts.

Expected markdown:
- `\lookup{alpha}` -> `alpha`
- `\lookup{beta-gamma}` -> `beta-gamma`
